questions.question: Which AWS service would you choose for a data processing project that needs a schemaless database?

explanation.summary: DynamoDB is a schemaless NoSQL database service.
explanation.why: AWS defines DynamoDB as a NoSQL key-value and document database with flexible schema.

explanation.summary: Redshift is a structured data warehouse service.
explanation.why: AWS defines Redshift as a relational data warehouse requiring predefined schemas.

explanation.summary: Aurora is a relational database requiring schema definition.
explanation.why: AWS defines Aurora as a relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL.

explanation.summary: RDS is a managed relational database service.
explanation.why: AWS defines RDS as supporting structured relational databases with schemas.

questions.question: The DevOps team is trying to debug performance issues in a serverless microservices application. Which AWS service should be used?

explanation.summary: Pinpoint is used for customer engagement, not debugging.
explanation.why: AWS defines Pinpoint as a messaging and analytics service for user engagement.

explanation.summary: X-Ray traces and analyzes distributed applications.
explanation.why: AWS defines X-Ray as a service for debugging and tracing microservices applications.

explanation.summary: Trusted Advisor provides best practice recommendations.
explanation.why: AWS defines Trusted Advisor as a service for optimization checks, not tracing.

explanation.summary: CloudFormation provisions infrastructure, not debugging.
explanation.why: AWS defines CloudFormation as an infrastructure-as-code service.

questions.question: Which benefit of cloud computing allows AWS to offer lower pay-as-you-go prices due to aggregated usage?

explanation.summary: This refers to global deployment capability.
explanation.why: AWS defines this as rapid global deployment, not pricing reduction.

explanation.summary: Aggregated usage reduces costs through economies of scale.
explanation.why: AWS defines economies of scale as lowering costs due to large-scale usage aggregation.

explanation.summary: This refers to faster deployment and innovation.
explanation.why: AWS defines speed and agility as rapid provisioning, not cost reduction.

options.text: Trade capital expense for variable expense

explanation.summary: This refers to pay-as-you-go pricing model.
explanation.why: AWS defines this as shifting cost structure, not aggregation-driven pricing.

questions.question: Which of the following are serverless computing services offered by AWS?

explanation.summary: Lambda is a serverless compute service.
explanation.why: AWS defines Lambda as running code without provisioning servers.

explanation.summary: Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers.
explanation.why: AWS defines Fargate as serverless container execution without managing servers.

explanation.summary: EC2 requires server management.
explanation.why: AWS defines EC2 as infrastructure-as-a-service with user-managed instances.

explanation.summary: Lightsail provides VPS instances requiring management.
explanation.why: AWS defines Lightsail as a simplified virtual server service.

questions.question: Which AWS service provides operational insights into AWS resources to identify issues impacting applications?

explanation.summary: Trusted Advisor provides best practice recommendations.
explanation.why: AWS defines Trusted Advisor as advisory checks, not operational insights.

explanation.summary: Inspector focuses on vulnerability scanning.
explanation.why: AWS defines Inspector as a security assessment service.

explanation.summary: Systems Manager provides operational visibility and insights.
explanation.why: AWS defines Systems Manager as offering centralized operational data and resource management.

options.text: AWS Health Dashboard – Your Account Health

explanation.summary: AWS Health shows service events affecting accounts.
explanation.why: AWS defines AWS Health as providing service event visibility, not resource-level insights.

questions.question: A healthcare startup stores anonymized patient health data on Amazon S3. Which AWS service can discover and identify sensitive data to prevent leaks?

explanation.summary: Glue is a data integration service, not for sensitive data discovery.
explanation.why: AWS defines Glue as an ETL service for data preparation and transformation.

explanation.summary: Polly is a text-to-speech service.
explanation.why: AWS defines Polly as converting text into lifelike speech.

explanation.summary: Macie discovers and classifies sensitive data in S3.
explanation.why: AWS defines Macie as using ML to identify and protect sensitive data in S3.

explanation.summary: Secrets Manager stores and manages secrets.
explanation.why: AWS defines Secrets Manager as a service for managing credentials and secrets.

questions.question: Which AWS service can be used to subscribe to an RSS feed for AWS service interruptions?

explanation.summary: SNS is a messaging service, not an AWS status RSS feed provider.
explanation.why: AWS defines SNS as a pub/sub messaging service.

options.text: AWS Health Dashboard – Your Account Health

explanation.summary: Account Health provides personalized events, not global RSS feeds.
explanation.why: AWS defines it as account-specific health visibility.

explanation.summary: Lambda is a compute service.
explanation.why: AWS defines Lambda as serverless compute.

explanation.summary: Service Health provides RSS feeds for AWS service status.
explanation.why: AWS defines Service Health Dashboard as public status with RSS subscription.

questions.question: Which AWS service can forecast AWS account usage and costs?

questions.question: Which solution supports speech input and speech output in an application?

explanation.summary: Services are reversed.
explanation.why: AWS defines Polly as text-to-speech and Transcribe as speech-to-text.

explanation.summary: Translate does not convert speech to text.
explanation.why: AWS defines Translate as language translation service.

explanation.summary: Incorrect services for speech input/output.
explanation.why: AWS defines Polly as text-to-speech only.

explanation.summary: Correct combination for speech-to-text and text-to-speech.

questions.question: A start-up would like to quickly deploy a popular technology on AWS. Which AWS tool would you use?

explanation.summary: CodeDeploy automates application deployments.
explanation.why: AWS defines CodeDeploy as a deployment service, not a prebuilt solution provider.

explanation.summary: Whitepapers provide guidance, not deployment tools.
explanation.why: AWS defines whitepapers as documentation resources.

explanation.summary: Forums are for discussions.
explanation.why: AWS defines forums as community support channels.

explanation.summary: Partner Solutions provide prebuilt deployments.

questions.question: Which of the following are correct statements regarding the AWS Shared Responsibility Model?

options.text: AWS maintains guest OS for EC2

explanation.summary: Statement is too broad and not precise.

options.text: AWS is responsible for security of the cloud

explanation.summary: AWS secures underlying infrastructure.
explanation.why: AWS defines its responsibility as security of the cloud.

options.text: AWS manages infrastructure, OS, and platform for S3

explanation.summary: S3 is a fully managed service.

questions.question: Which practice allows security assessments without prior AWS approval?

explanation.summary: AWS allows penetration testing without prior approval.
explanation.why: AWS policy permits penetration testing on approved services.

explanation.summary: Inspector is a scanning service.
explanation.why: AWS defines Inspector as vulnerability assessment, not a policy.

explanation.summary: Secrets Manager stores credentials.

explanation.summary: Stress testing is restricted.

questions.question: Which AWS services are always free to use?

questions.question: A company wants to separate AWS costs by department. What is the simplest way?

questions.question: AWS Organizations provides which of the following benefits? (Select two)

options.text: Provision Amazon EC2 Spot instances across the member AWS accounts

explanation.summary: Provisioning Spot Instances is not a feature of AWS Organizations.
explanation.why: AWS Organizations manages accounts and billing, not EC2 provisioning operations.

options.text: Check vulnerabilities on Amazon EC2 instances across the member AWS accounts

explanation.summary: Vulnerability scanning is not provided by AWS Organizations.
explanation.why: Security assessments are handled by services like Amazon Inspector, not Organizations.

options.text: Share the reserved Amazon EC2 instances amongst the member AWS accounts

explanation.summary: Reserved Instance sharing across accounts is a benefit of AWS Organizations.
explanation.why: Organizations enables consolidated billing and sharing of RI discounts across accounts.

options.text: Volume discounts for Amazon EC2 and Amazon S3 aggregated across the member AWS accounts

explanation.summary: Aggregated usage across accounts enables volume discounts.
explanation.why: Organizations combines usage across accounts for pricing benefits under consolidated billing.

questions.question: AWS Marketplace facilitates which of the following use cases? (Select two)

options.text: Request the purchase of AWS Direct Connect connection

options.text: Sell Software as a Service (SaaS) solutions to AWS customers

options.text: AWS customers can buy software bundled into customized Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) by AWS Marketplace sellers

questions.question: Which of the following is a container service of AWS?

explanation.summary: Elastic Beanstalk is a PaaS service.

questions.question: An IT company is on a cost-optimization spree and wants to identify all Amazon EC2 instances that are under-utilized. Which AWS services can be used off-the-shelf to address this use case without needing any manual configurations? (Select two)

explanation.summary: CUR provides detailed billing data but not automated recommendations.
explanation.why: AWS CUR delivers raw usage data, not prebuilt optimization insights.

explanation.summary: CloudWatch provides metrics to identify underutilized EC2 instances.
explanation.why: CloudWatch monitors resource utilization such as CPU usage for EC2 instances.

explanation.summary: Trusted Advisor provides cost optimization recommendations including idle EC2 instances.

explanation.summary: Cost Explorer analyzes cost trends but not resource utilization directly.

questions.question: A startup runs its proprietary application on docker containers. As a Cloud Practitioner, which AWS service would you recommend so that the startup can run containers and still have access to the underlying servers?

explanation.summary: Fargate abstracts the underlying servers.
explanation.why: Fargate is serverless and does not provide access to underlying infrastructure.

explanation.summary: ECS allows running containers with control over underlying EC2 instances.
explanation.why: ECS with EC2 launch type provides access to underlying servers.

explanation.summary: ECR is a container image registry, not a runtime service.
explanation.why: ECR stores container images but does not run containers.

explanation.summary: Lambda abstracts infrastructure and does not provide server access.
explanation.why: Lambda is serverless and does not expose underlying servers.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is the MOST accurate when describing AWS Elastic Beanstalk?

options.text: It is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that allows you to model and provision resources needed for an application

explanation.summary: This describes infrastructure provisioning tools like CloudFormation.
explanation.why: Modeling and provisioning resources is associated with IaC services, not Elastic Beanstalk.

options.text: It is a Platform as a Service (PaaS) that allows you to deploy and scale web applications and services

explanation.summary: Elastic Beanstalk is a PaaS for deploying and scaling applications.
explanation.why: Elastic Beanstalk manages infrastructure while enabling application deployment and scaling.

options.text: It is an Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) that allows you to deploy and scale web applications and services

explanation.summary: Elastic Beanstalk is not an IaaS service.
explanation.why: Elastic Beanstalk abstracts infrastructure management unlike IaaS.

options.text: It is an Infrastructure as Code (IaC) that allows you to model and provision resources needed for an application

explanation.summary: Elastic Beanstalk is not an IaC service.
explanation.why: IaC capabilities are provided by AWS CloudFormation, not Elastic Beanstalk.

questions.question: Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework recommends maintaining infrastructure as code (IaC)?

explanation.why: IaC is not a primary concept of cost management.

explanation.summary: Performance Efficiency focuses on resource performance.
explanation.why: IaC is not primarily defined under performance efficiency.

explanation.summary: Security focuses on protecting systems and data.
explanation.why: IaC is primarily part of operational practices, not security.

explanation.summary: Operational Excellence recommends using infrastructure as code.
